svg.title: Recorder controls and independent training outputs
svg.desc: Choose saved motion separately from dataset purpose. Both consumers share one raw recording. Export after recording independent train, validation and test sessions. Validation is not an accuracy guarantee.
svg.text: TWO INDEPENDENT CHOICES IN THE CONTROL PANEL
Which training exporters will consume the recording?
ONE RAW SOURCE | Native 224 or 448 | No crop
6 views + labels + calibration + robot/actions. Random lights + drape. No duplicate RGB for Both.
Native PNG + masks + visible COCO boxes
RGB-only model; one instance per class
SESSION SPLITS: distinct train / valid / test seeds; never split adjacent frames.
Before launch: select drive, check capacity + reserve. Logs stay under debug/logs.
Recording/export PASS is not model quality PASS. Held-out metrics + learned rollouts still required.
